name: Serengeti Migration
tagline: Witness the Greatest Wildlife Show on Earth
intro: The Serengeti is Africa's most iconic wilderness — 30,000 square kilometres of open savanna where over two million wildebeest, zebra, and gazelle make an annual pilgrimage in one of nature's most dramatic spectacles. Beyond the migration, the Serengeti's resident predator populations are among the densest on earth.

signatureExperiences.title: River Crossing Viewings
signatureExperiences.description: Witness wildebeest plunging into the Mara River in a churning, heart-stopping crossing as crocodiles lie in wait. Our guides position you at the best vantage points.

signatureExperiences.title: Dawn Game Drive
signatureExperiences.description: As the first light breaks over the plains, predators make their final hunts. Our pre-dawn departures put you in position when the action is at its peak.

signatureExperiences.title: Hot Air Balloon Safari
signatureExperiences.description: Drift silently above the endless plains as dawn reveals the scale of the migration below. Touch down for a champagne breakfast in the bush.

signatureExperiences.title: Big Cat Tracking
signatureExperiences.description: Work with our specialist guides to track lion prides, cheetah families, and elusive leopards resting in fever trees.

wildlifeHighlights.notes: Serengeti has one of Africa's densest lion populations. Kopjes — rocky outcrops — are favourite resting spots.
1.5 million wildebeest participate in the annual migration; calving season in the southern Serengeti is equally spectacular.
The open plains make cheetah sightings and hunt observations more reliable here than almost anywhere else in Africa.

lodging.name: Singita Grumeti
lodging.description: A world-renowned collection of lodges and camps on a private 350,000-acre concession in the western Serengeti corridor.

lodging.name: Nomad Lamai
lodging.description: Perched on a kopje in the northern Serengeti with commanding views over the Mara River area — prime migration territory.

bestTimeToVisit: June–October for the river crossings; January–March for calving season in the southern Serengeti
